race.comment: Wide open with a myriad of win chances. ANAHORISH (13) tackled a similar race fresh and wound up strongly to just miss. Fitter again and can go one better. HE'S A COOL CAT (14) registered a strong win at Murray Bridge two runs ago then kept coming on the Parks track last time, beaten 1.5 lengths. Nicely placed to take this out. BRIMARVI ROSEMARIE (11) has been thereabouts without winning, the latest winding up powerfully to be beaten less than a length at Morphettville Parks. Drops in the weights for this. Form sound and among the chances here. DAMPEN (12) has been out of the winner's list for a long time, last start finishing ninth at this track over 1050m after he gave away a big start. Better than that and will wind up late. UP THE DEN (2) has a tricky gate but string early pace and will be in this for a long way.
